# Introduction

This project examines differences in patient
outcomes among children receiving standard F75
formula compared with modified F75 formula.

# Research Question

How do children with malnutrition receiving the
standard F75 formula and those receiving the
modified F75 formula differ in patient outcomes
(weight at stabilization and days to stabilization)?

# Methods

Dataset: F75 dataset
